observation.command:
set -e
V=/tmp/nebu-validate; mkdir -p $V; cd $V
# Step 1: initiate Matrix SSO redirect for oidc
echo "=== 1. Matrix SSO redirect ==="
curl -sS -m 10 -o /dev/null -D sso_h.txt -c cookies.txt "http://localhost:8008/_matrix/client/v3/login/sso/redirect/oidc?redirectUrl=http%3A%2F%2Flocalhost%3A8008%2Fcapture"
grep -i '^location:' sso_h.txt
DEXAUTH=$(grep -i '^location:' sso_h.txt | awk '{print $2}' | tr -d '\r')
echo "dex auth url: $DEXAUTH"
# Step 2: fetch Dex login page, extract state+nonce
echo "=== 2. Dex auth page ==="
curl -sS -m 10 -c dex_cookies.txt -o dex_auth.html "$DEXAUTH" -w 'HTTP:%{http_code}\n'
STATE=$(grep -o 'name="state" value="[^"]*"' dex_auth.html | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//')
NONCE=$(grep -o 'name="nonce" value="[^"]*"' dex_auth.html | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//')
echo "state=$STATE nonce=$NONCE"
# Step 3: Dex login form (basic)
echo "=== 3. Dex login as kai ==="
curl -sS -m 10 -b dex_cookies.txt -c dex_cookies.txt -o dex_post.html --data-urlencode "username=kai@example.com" --data-urlencode "password=changeme" --data-urlencode "state=$STATE" --data-urlencode "nonce=$NONCE" "$DEXAUTH" -w 'HTTP:%{http_code}\n'
cat dex_post.html | head -c 300; echo
